name: Breakthrough
strategy: Reach resistant positions, overcome defenders, and maintain pressure after entering Engagement.

commands.name: Breach Guard
commands.effect: If the active Unit successfully Charged this Round, it gains Accurate 2 on its next Melee Attack against an Armored target. If the target had Brace during the Charge, also gain +1 Attack die.

commands.name: Momentum Drive
commands.effect: The active Unit gains Charge 2 when declaring its next Charge this Assault Phase. Charge Impact is unchanged.

commands.name: Siege Breaker
commands.effect: The active Unit gains Anti-[chosen matching type] 4 on its next Attack against an Armored Unit, Monster, Vehicle, War Machine, or Fortification this Phase. Against a Structure or Fortification, the Attack also gains +1 Damage.

commands.name: Press the Breach
commands.effect: After the active Unit inflicts unsaved Damage on an enemy Engaged with it, that enemy loses one bonus Unit of objective-control counting until the end of the Round, down to its ordinary minimum.

commands.name: Command the Breach
commands.effect: When a friendly Unit within Short of friendly Headquarters that successfully Charged this Round is attacked in Engagement, grant it Tough 2 against that Attack.

doctrineIdentity: Charge reliability and overcoming defended positions. Breakthrough differs from Alpha Strike by concentrating on reaching and penetrating targets rather than maximizing immediate Attack volume.
